description: IDS encrypted data payload type - CloudEvents compliant. Contains only encrypted business content (structured extracted data) and security envelope following CloudEvents v1.0 specification. Processing metadata is exposed as root-level extension attributes on SAFIDSEventType.

payload.description: Base64 representation of gzip-compressed and encrypted data. Contains structured output from document processing. Uses AES-GCM algorithm with 256-bit key, 96-bit initialization vector (IV), and 128-bit authentication tag.

payloadSignature.description: Digital signature for integrity verification of encrypted payload. Created by signing payload using ECDSA with secp384r1 curve and SHA-384 hash. Encoded in ASN.1 format and transmitted as Base64.

encryptionKey.description: Encrypted AES symmetric key used to decrypt the payload. Key was encrypted with eventReceiver's public key using RSA with OAEP padding and SHA-256 hash. Transmitted as Base64.

publicKeyVersion.description: Version identifier of the recipient's public key used to encrypt the encryptionKey. Determines which private key can decrypt the key.

signatureKeyVersion.description: Version identifier of the sender's signature key used to sign the payload. Determines which public key can verify the signature.
